summary: Paranovus Entertainment Technology Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a change in certifying accountant and a private placement of 12,500 Class B ordinary shares at $8.00 per share (130% of the June 29, 2026 closing price) to an affiliate, raising $100,000. The board's audit committee approved the transaction, which closed on July 2, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising transaction by the issuer, not a transformative special situation. No special-situation classification applies.
